title: nf-core/gwas pipeline - analysis manifest schema
description: Schema for the analysis manifest provided with params.analysis_manifest. One row declares one cohort and trait analysis unit.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for the analysis unit and the focal identifier used in output paths and filenames.
analysis_id.errorMessage: Analysis ID must be provided, must be unique across the analysis manifest and cannot contain spaces

cohort_id.description: Identifier of the cohort declared in the cohort manifest.
cohort_id.errorMessage: Cohort ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_id.description: Identifier of the trait under analysis.
trait_id.errorMessage: Trait ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

trait_type.description: Declared trait type, which is never inferred from phenotype values.
trait_type.errorMessage: Trait type must be one of 'quantitative' or 'binary'

phenotype.description: Headered phenotype file containing the named trait column.
phenotype.errorMessage: Phenotype file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must exist

phenotype_column.description: Name of the phenotype column holding this trait.
phenotype_column.errorMessage: Phenotype column must be provided and cannot contain spaces

control_value.description: Optional source value used for controls on a binary trait.
control_value.errorMessage: Control value must be a single token without spaces, for example '1' or 'Control'

case_value.description: Optional source value used for cases on a binary trait.
case_value.errorMessage: Case value must be a single token without spaces, for example '2' or 'Case'

quant_covariates.description: Optional headered file of quantitative covariates.
quant_covariates.errorMessage: Quantitative covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

cat_covariates.description: Optional headered file of categorical covariates.
cat_covariates.errorMessage: Categorical covariate file cannot contain spaces and must exist

association_methods.description: Comma-delimited supported association methods selected for this analysis.
association_methods.errorMessage: Association methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

heritability_methods.description: Comma-delimited supported heritability methods selected for this analysis.
heritability_methods.errorMessage: Heritability methods must be a comma-delimited list of lowercase tokens with no spaces

population_prevalence.description: Optional population prevalence for binary-trait heritability methods that consume liability-scale prevalence.
population_prevalence.errorMessage: Population prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1

sample_prevalence.description: Optional sample case fraction for a binary trait.
sample_prevalence.errorMessage: Sample prevalence must be a number strictly between 0 and 1
